note: プロンプトビルダーの選択肢。value が英語の断片、label が日本語、hint が選ぶ基準。7スロット構造（被写体→動作→環境→カメラ→光→質感→スタイル）の順に連結される。

set.lightDir: backlight from behind and slightly above the subject, with a weak soft fill from the front left
window light as the only source, no overhead ceiling light
set.texture: matte plaster and raw timber surfaces

set.lightDir: side light from the left with a white bounce from the right
set.texture: matte packaging with a slight sheen on the sealed edge
set.move: slow orbit around the subject, 30 degrees of rotation only

set.lightDir: window light as the only source, no overhead ceiling light
set.texture: matte wall surfaces and wood flooring

set.lightDir: window light as the only source, no overhead ceiling light
set.texture: natural fabric and matte desk surfaces
set.move: static shot, camera does not move

set.texture: rough concrete, steel and timber surfaces
